messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty fired: INC-42422 — inference-embed-queue-eu (SEV2). Symptoms: sustained 5xx spike + embed queue depth > 400. Affected: multiple PLG customers, high latencies. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incident-embed-queue :rotating_light:
kevin: ack — taking ownership. Starting triage, pulling logs and metrics now.
pagerbot: PagerDuty assigned INC-42422 to @kevin.
dana: @kevin pinged — available to help with scaling/quota side if needed.
kevin: quick findings: worker timeouts and OOMs on embedder pods. `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep embedder` shows several restarts (3/6 restarts).
emily: adding customer-impact note: multiple customers reporting 10-20s latencies and intermittent 5xxs. I'll draft an initial status page.
kevin: tried scaling dedicated pool but autoscaler returned errors; looks like cloud quota/RequestLimitExceeded. Snippet: ```api error: RequestLimitExceeded: Rate exceeded for project```
jules: I'll loop infra/quota. @dana can we also consider routing fallback to other region while quota ramps?
dana: fallback to us-west-2 would increase p95 by ~100ms but should reduce errors. I'm provisioning capacity in us-west-2 now — ETA ~6m.
kevin: mitigation step: applying emergency fallback policy to route 40% of low-priority traffic to us-west-2 to relieve eu-west-1. Command run: `redwood route set --policy fallback --percent 40 --from eu-west-1 --to us-west-2 --priority low`
incidentbot: Note: fallback policy applied by @kevin at 4242201290.
emily: status page posted (initial PSA): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/424220 — included mitigations and customer guidance.
pagerbot: PagerDuty: Escalation scheduled to L2 if no update in 10m.
kevin: update: error rate down ~60%, queue depth trending down. Still seeing OOMs on two older instances; restarting affected pods with higher memory requests now. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embedder-v2 -n inference`
dana: infra quota team responded — increasing pod quota in eu-west-1 by +10, changes expected to propagate in ~4m.
jules: :thumbsup: prepping post-incident note template and RCA checklist.
kevin: handoff incoming — I'll pass ownership to @dana in ~10m for follow-up and remediation. Reason: quota increase pending and infra actions in progress. Current status: recovering, traffic partially routed to us-west-2, error rate near baseline. Next steps: confirm quota applied, monitor for evictions, ship memory-leak patch.
dana: acked handoff — will take over monitoring and coordinate the postmortem. Tagging SRE rotation for follow-up.
incidentbot: Incidentbot update: autoclaim window closed, no further pages. Incident state: degraded -> recovering.
